title: Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Launch Pre-Order Card Authorizations: Renewal and Declines
content:
**Renewal.** Under Pre-Orders & Back-Orders, a Launch Pre-Order's card authorization is renewed every 7 calendar days while the reservation is open. That figure is the type's authorization renewal period. A renewal is attempted only while the reservation is in status reserved, awaiting consent or allocated.

**Declines.** When a renewal is declined, or the capture at shipment is declined, the customer has the type's hours to update a declined card, counted from the decline. For the Launch Pre-Order this is 24 hours. After that, the reservation is cancelled for the reason payment declined and its unit is released to the next reservation.

**Renewal attempts by status**

| Status of the Launch Pre-Order | Renewal attempted |
|---|---|
| Reserved | Yes |
| Awaiting consent | Yes |
| Allocated | Yes |
| Fulfilled | No |
| Cancelled | No |

**Timing illustration (hypothetical)**

- Reserved on 2 May. Renewals fall 7 calendar days apart while the reservation stays open: 9 May, 16 May, and so on.
- A renewal is declined at 14:00 on 16 May. The customer may update the card until 14:00 on 17 May. If the card is still declined after that, the reservation is cancelled for payment declined and the unit goes to the next reservation.
